Prevention: Plough the soil twice before sowing the crop to kill the inoculum.
Remove the stubble after harvesting and destroy by burning to reduce the primary and secondary inoculums.
Avoid excess usage of nitrogenous fertilizers (recommended dosage of nitrogen fertilizer is 12.25 kg).
Maintain soil moisture with a proper irrigation schedule.
Irrigate immediately after sowing and light irrigation on the third day.
Irrigate at intervals of 7 to 10 days depending upon soil and climatic conditions.
Monitoring: Disease infestation occurs at the vegetative stage.
Observe leaves for red/brown raised pustules under a microscope or hand lens.
Dark brown rusty pustules (uredia) appear on the lower surface of the leaves.
Dark brown rusty pustules (uredia) appear on the upper surface of the leaves.
In severe conditions observe for desiccated leaves and leaf drop at seed setting stage or pod formation stage.
Direct Control: Pseudomonas fluorescence at 10 gm/kg of seeds and shade dry for 15 minutes before sowing.
Restrictions: Sulphur at 1500 g/Ha at 10 day intervals.
WP followed by two more sprays at 10 day intervals.
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use).
